title: Initial cell seeding density is a control knob for Anthrobot size and maturation

fields.label: Label
fields.value: Initial cell seeding density is a control knob for Anthrobot size and maturation

fields.label: Statement
fields.value: Changing the initial seeding density of bronchial epithelial cells in Matrigel (half, default or double 30,000 cells/mL) significantly changes the resulting Anthrobot sizes and the time course of motility, though not linearly, suggesting that seeding density is a tractable control parameter for Anthrobot morphology and function.

fields.label: Work
fields.value: Motile Living Biobots Self-Construct from Adult Human Somatic Progenitor Seed Cells

fields.label: Chapter
fields.value: Gumuskaya G 2024, Motile Living Biobots Self-Construct from Adult Human Somatic Progenitor Seed Cells › Results › Human Bronchial Epithelial Cells Self‐Construct into Multicellular Motile Living Architectures

fields.label: Quotation
fields.value: These results show that the size and time course of maturation of motile bots could be modulated by altering the concentration of cells in the Anthrobot differentiation culture, suggesting initial cell seeding density to be a tractable control knob for Anthrobot morphology and function.

fields.label: Assumptions
fields.value: Gumuskaya G, Srivastava P, Cooper BG, Lesser H, Semegran B, Garnier S, Levin M, “Motile Living Biobots Self-Construct from Adult Human Somatic Progenitor Seed Cells”, Advanced science (Weinheim, Baden-Wurttemberg, Germany) (2024), doi:10.1002/advs.202303575; section “Results › Human Bronchial Epithelial Cells Self‐Construct into Multicellular Motile Living Architectures”. Scope: NHBE-derived Anthrobots in vitro, seeding densities 15,000–60,000 cells/mL

fields.label: Assessment
fields.value: GPT-5.6 Sol on levin-2024-anthrobots-06: partially-resolvable, resolvability 0.75

fields.label: Finding
fields.value: The intervention and outcomes are directly measurable and the public supplement reports all three conditions. The limited dose range supports modulation but only partially establishes a reliable control knob.

fields.label: Proposed test in the assessment
fields.value: Proposed test with existing data: Compare size distributions and bidaily motile fractions among 15000, 30000, and 60000 cells/mL cultures using a prespecified density-by-time model.

fields.label: Evidence against
fields.value:
Only three densities constrain the claimed control relationship.

Replicate-level culture independence may be unclear.

fields.label: Dimension scores
fields.value:
discriminating power: 0.82
data adequacy: 0.52
data existence: 0.64
analysis feasibility: 0.88
operationalizability: 0.97

fields.label: Finding
fields.value: Seeding density, diameter and motile fraction are all measured quantities, and the paper describes half, default and double density. Those curves remain with the authors. Without the replicate table, the significance and the non-linear shape cannot be recomputed from open data.

fields.label: Proposed test in the assessment
fields.value: Proposed test with existing data: At 15,000, 30,000 and 60,000 cells per millilitre, record final bot diameter and the day-by-day motile fraction. A significant, non-linear shift in both size and the motility time course would support seeding density as a control parameter; overlapping size distributions, or a strictly linear response, would refute the stated pattern.

fields.label: Evidence against
fields.value:
Density also changes nutrient and oxygen competition, so it is not a pure morphological knob.

Three-density size and motility curves are not deposited.

Non-linearity is hard to establish from three points without the raw replicates.

fields.label: Dimension scores
fields.value:
analysis feasibility: 0.22
operationalizability: 0.88
data adequacy: 0.2
data existence: 0.2
discriminating power: 0.5
